_comment: What the food trade says on the timeline.
THESE ARE BARE MINIMUM'S OWN VOICES, not Hoodrich's. Hoodrich's feed is the block
talking about itself -- sets, corners, who did what to who. This is the people who
sell you lunch: a hot dog man with opinions about the weather, a buffet that has
never once undersold itself, and a corner store that has been closing down for
three weeks. Different register on purpose. A shop that posted like a gang member
would read as the same system wearing a hat.
NOTHING HERE HAPPENS UNLESS HOODRICH IS INSTALLED. Bare Minimum has no feed of its
own and is not growing one; it hands a finished post to Hoodrich's and stays out of
the way. With Hoodrich absent the whole file is never even read.
authors   who posts. handle and name are what the timeline shows.
'vendor' ties an author to a vendor id in vendors.json, so the hot dog
man's account only ever posts about the hot dog stand.
'vendor' takes one id or a LIST of them, so a chain with two branches is one account.
'gang' is left empty: none of these people are in one.
posts     sets of lines, keyed by what just happened.
ambient    nothing in particular, they just posted.
bought     you have just bought something from them.
closing    they are shutting for the night.
opening    they are back on.
away       they have stepped off the pitch for a minute.
slots     {word} substitutions, picked at random. Same idea as Hoodrich's.
{shop} is always the vendor's own name, so one line serves every stall without
any of them sounding like the others.

complaint: people asking for the wifi password
a man who wanted it well done
the guy who parks across my pitch

ambient: {shop} is {praise} and I will not be taking questions.
If you are reading this you are already too far from {shop}.
Fresh today. Fresher than yesterday, anyway.
New sign went up. Same everything else.
Everything is going. Everything must go. Some of it should have gone last week.
Reminder that we have a menu and you are allowed to read it before you get to the front.
Third person {timeofday} has asked if we take card. Nothing has changed since the first one.
Open. Still open. Will be open after you have decided.
Prices are on the wall. They have been on the wall the whole time.
We are here every day and somebody still asks if we are new.
Somebody asked for the wifi password. There is no wifi. There is {shop}.
If we are shut it is because we are shut, not because something has happened.
Come in, buy something, leave. It is not complicated and we like it that way.
bought: Big order just went out. Somebody out there is having a day.
The {item} is moving today. Get in while it is still warm.
Just served a guy who did not say a word. Respect.
That is the last of the {item} for now. Come back later.
Somebody paid full price and did not complain. Framing the receipt.
closing: That is me done. Back in the morning.
Packing up. If you are running down the street right now, you are too late.
opening: Back on the corner. Missed you.
Grill is on. Give it ten minutes.
We are open and I have already had an argument. Good start.
away: Stepped away for two minutes. Two. Minutes.
Having a cigarette. The cart is not going anywhere and neither am I.
Back in five. Do not touch anything.
ambient:cart: Cart is out. Come get one before I eat the stock myself.
Somebody asked me today if the hot dogs are vegan. They are hot dogs.
Whoever left a scooter across my pitch: I know what you look like.
Rolled the cart out at {timeofday} and my back has opinions.
No seating. There has never been seating. It is a cart.
Onions are on unless you say otherwise. That is the system.
Rain means I go home. That is the whole business plan.
Man just tried to haggle. On a hot dog. On a CART.
The umbrella is decorative. Stand where you like.
Cash. I have said cash for eleven years.
If the cart is here I am here. If it is not, I am not.
Somebody stole my mustard. My MUSTARD.
ambient:fastfood: Fryers are hot and the queue is not long. Both of those change.
Yes we are open. The sign is old, the shop is open.
Somebody asked what is in it. Ask a different question.
Hot and quick. That is the promise and that is the whole promise.
The bins outside are for the bins outside. Not the doorway.
We do takeaway, we do eat in, we do not do lingering.
One till, one of me, {timeofday}. Be patient or be quick.
The heat lamp is doing its best.
If it is on the board we have it. If it is not, we do not.
Napkins are behind the counter now. You know why.
ambient:burger: Grill is on. Has been since {timeofday}.
Somebody asked for it well done. On a burger. It is a burger.
Buns come in fresh. That is not marketing, a man brings them in a van.
The drive-through speaker works. You do not need to shout.
Cheese is not extra. It has never been extra. Somebody keeps saying it is.
Yes there is a vegetarian option. It is the fries.
Milkshake machine is working today. Do not ask about tomorrow.
We do not do half portions. You will not need one.
Every review says the same thing and every review is correct.
Pickles on the side if you ask. Ask at the counter, not after.
ambient:chicken: Fresh batch out of the fryer. Come now or come later and be sad.
Wings, thighs, or the box. That is the decision tree.
Somebody asked which bird. Sir. It is chicken.
The queue at {timeofday} tells you everything about the chicken.
Hot sauce is on the counter and it is free. Do not take the bottle.
We season before AND after. That is the difference.
Bones in the bin, not on the table. We are asking nicely.
Family bucket feeds a family. A real one. Not one guy.
The fryer does not care what time you turn up. I do, slightly.
If it is not crispy bring it back. Nobody ever brings it back.
ambient:taco: Salsa is made this morning. Every morning.
Three is a snack. Five is lunch. Do not order two.
Somebody asked for a fork. For a taco.
Yes it is spicy. That is not a warning, it is a description.
Lengua is on today. If you know, you know.
The window is open until it is not.
Limes are free. One. Not the bowl.
Everything is fresh because we do not have anywhere to store anything.
Corn or flour. That is the only argument worth having here.
We are busy at {timeofday} because we are good at {timeofday}.
ambient:noodle: All you can eat means all YOU can eat. Not all your cousin can eat.
Buffet is refilled every twenty minutes and somebody still hovers.
The wok does not stop. Neither do I.
Chopsticks are by the door. Forks are also by the door. No judgement.
Somebody asked if the noodles are gluten free. They are noodles.
Steam is not smoke. Nobody needs to call anybody.
One bowl, one price, and the bowl is a proper bowl.
Takeaway containers cost us money now. That is not a complaint, it is context.
The lunch rush is {timeofday} and it is not a rumour.
We do not do small. There is a size and it is the size.
ambient:coffee: Beans came in {timeofday}. The good ones.
The pavement tables are first come. That is the entire seating policy.
Somebody ordered a coffee with eleven words in it. We made it. We are professionals.
Yes there is a bathroom. It is for customers, as it says on the door.
Nobody has ever needed a laptop for six hours. Nobody.
The machine is hissing because that is what the machine does.
We open before you are awake and we mean that literally.
Milk of every kind, and one of them costs more, and it is not our fault.
Loyalty card is real. Ten stamps. We have never not honoured it.
It is hot. It is coffee. Please do not sue us.
ambient:donut: Rings are out. Singly or by the dozen, and the dozen is better value.
Glaze is still setting. Ten minutes. It is worth ten minutes.
Somebody asked for a healthy one. Sir. Madam. Look around.
We start at four in the morning so you do not have to.
Baker's dozen is thirteen. It has always been thirteen.
The jam ones sell out first. Every day. Adjust accordingly.
Coffee and a ring is a breakfast. Two rings is a decision.
Sprinkles are not a flavour but people order them like they are.
Nothing here was made yesterday. Nothing.
The box is free. The handle on the box is also free.
ambient:pizza: Have it your way. That is on the window and we meant it.
Oven is at temperature. Everything after that is fast.
Somebody asked for pineapple. We do not comment on that.
Slices at lunch, whole pies after. That is the rhythm.
The box is recyclable. The crusts you left in it are not.
By the slice means by the slice. It does not mean a small one.
Delivery goes as far as the sensible end of the neighbourhood.
Somebody rang and asked if we do pizza.
Extra cheese is a real option and not a personality.
It is ready when it is ready. Standing closer will not help.
ambient:juice: Wheatgrass shot is on the counter and it will change your afternoon.
Everything is pressed here. Nothing arrives in a carton.
Somebody asked if the juice is healthy. It is fruit and sugar. Do the maths.
Yes it is expensive. Look at how much fruit is in it.
Smoothies at {timeofday} are a different drink to smoothies at midday.
Ginger is not optional in that one. It is the point of that one.
The blender is loud. That is how you know it is working.
We do not do a small. The small was not doing anything for anybody.
Detox is not a medical term but it does move product.
Straws are paper now and everybody has already made the joke.
ambient:tobacco: Tobacconist, pipes, confectioners and cigars. It is on the sign and it is all true.
The humidor is not a fridge and I will not be explaining it again.
Somebody came in for a lighter and left with a pipe. That is a good day.
Cigars behind the counter. Sweets in front of it. Both sell.
We do not sell to anybody who cannot prove it. Do not ask twice.
There is a right way to cut one and there is your way.
Pipe tobacco smells better than it tastes and everybody finds out.
The sweets are for the children of the men buying the cigars.
Prices went up because the tax went up. Take it up with them.
Open late. This is a business built on people remembering at nine at night.
ambient:fuel: Pumps are open, shop is open, and the shop is the better half.
Card at the pump or pay inside. Either way, pay.
Air and water round the side. Both free. Both work.
Widest shelf on this side of town and people still come in for one thing.
Coffee at the machine is better than it has any right to be.
Do not smoke on the forecourt. This is not a joke I am making.
Somebody drove off without their receipt AND without their card.
Twenty four hours. Every hour. Including the ones nobody wants.
Pump four has been out since {timeofday}. Somebody is coming.
The hot food case is stocked. It has been a long night for both of us.
Wiper fluid is by the door because in this weather you will want it.
If the tap is running out front, tell me, do not just watch it.
ambient:diner: Breakfast until eleven. After that it is the plate.
Coffee is bottomless and I mean that as a warning.
Booths are for two or more. The counter is right there.
Somebody asked for breakfast at four in the afternoon. We said yes. We always say yes.
Open twenty four hours, which means somebody is always having a strange night in here.
The specials board is the specials board. It has been the same special for a while.
Refills are free. Ask, do not just hold the cup up.
You can sit as long as you like. Most people find that out.
Two eggs, any way, and we can genuinely do any way.
The night shift sees things. The night shift says nothing.
ambient:liquor: Spirits, beer, and something to eat. That is the whole shop and it is enough.
We check every time. Every single time. Do not make it a thing.
Cold ones are in the back fridge and the back fridge is working today.
Somebody asked what pairs with it. Sir, this is a liquor store.
Repossession sale is still on because the repossession is still happening.
Cash after midnight. That is for everybody's safety, mine included.
The deli counter is a real deli counter. People do not believe it.
Do not drink it outside the door. I am asking as a neighbour.
Everything on the shelf is on the shelf. If it is not there, we are out.
Open late because that is when this shop makes sense.
ambient:market: Shelves are stocked, which is not something we can say every week.
Whatever is on the shelf today is what there is. That is the format.
Somebody asked for a substitution. It is a corner store.
The ATM is working. That is news, so I am reporting it.
Prices are going up on Monday. Not our idea and not our margin.
One thing at a time. That is not a rule, it is a description of the stock.
Somebody left a trolley in the road again.
We are still here, which given the windows is a genuine achievement.
Bread comes in at {timeofday} and it goes by nine.
The freezer is fixed. Everything in it is fine. Mostly fine.
Yes we sell that. Ask, do not stand there looking.
Closing time is closing time. The door will be locked and I will be inside.
